BiblicalUsage: Zabud is named once, in 1 Kings 4:5. In 1 Kings 4:5 we read, "And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer..."
TheologicalSignificance: Zabud appears only briefly, yet I hold that God knew this life fully.
